encounter.title: Combat pressure 5 — mini-boss (seed 1571)

phases.label: moved: direction becomes a resource, fresh attack window

encounter.notes: EXP-010 provisional, not user-approved. Same board/phases/seed as EXP-009's mini-boss (medium 1571, E 4hp -> N 5hp +1 Rotate), now with player HP and attack timers layered on per docs/COMBAT-RULES.md 10 encounter 5. attackTimer numbers are a first-pass tuning, deliberately gentle in phase 1 (interval 6, dmg 1: 4 phase-1 hits take exactly 4 turns, so 0 unavoidable phase-1 damage) and tighter in phase 2 (interval 3, dmg 1, fresh window on phase change). rotate.advancesTurn=false is Gemini's suggestion (relayed by the user), not a settled design decision -- flip it to see the alternative. Verified (see spikes/arrow-core/EXP-010-REPORT.md) at the entry HP the intended prologue chain actually produces (10 max HP - 6 unavoidable from cp-e4 = 4): under natural (hit-first) phase-1 play, Rotate cw is a dead end that empties the board with the player dead (0 HP) before the boss is finished; Rotate ccw wins with 3 HP to spare. minDamageToWin proves the true minimum unavoidable damage on any winning path is 1. This cw/ccw asymmetry is entry-HP dependent: from ~5+ HP entering, cw stops being fatal (the board still clears alive, which is now also a valid win per docs/COMBAT-RULES.md 8) -- the 'wrong Rotate loses' moment specifically depends on the player having already spent HP earlier in the chain, which is intentional given the chain's numbers, but fragile and worth a human playtest.
